subject: Dispute: INV-20251130 — service allocation and VAT reallocation
messages:
From: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@etahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Price <olivia.price@mccorp.co.uk>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discrepancy on INV-20251130 / VAT applied incorrectly

Hi Marcus / Laura,

We've been reconciling November invoices and noticed two issues on INV-20251130:

- There appears to be a duplicated line for "dedicated-inference-pool - Nov" (same quantity charged twice).
- VAT has been applied at 20% even though our account is registered in the EU (VAT ID GB999999999). We provided this VAT ID during onboarding; previous invoices from Q3 were zero-rated.

Can you confirm you received our VAT documentation and advise on next steps? If you can produce a corrected invoice and a credit memo for the duplicate charge, that would let our AP team process payment. We need the corrected paperwork by end of next week to avoid payment delays.

Attached: INV-20251130.pdf (copy from our remittance).

Thanks,
Tom
AP Manager, Eta Health
Attachments: INV-20251130.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@etahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on INV-20251130 / VAT applied incorrectly

Tom — thanks for flagging this. We're looking into it right now; I looped in Neha from Billing so she can pull the invoice history and VAT on file.

Two quick asks while we investigate:
1) Could you forward the VAT registration confirmation or the page from your portal that shows GB999999999? That speeds up the compliance check.
2) Can you confirm whether the duplicate line is exactly the same descriptor as the other line (you already attested it looks identical but any screenshot helps).

I'll aim to get a status update within 48 hours. If we confirm an error on our side, we'll issue a credit memo and a corrected invoice, and propose a service credit for the hassle.

Apologies for the trouble — we'll prioritize this.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@etahealth.com>, Olivia Price <olivia.price@mccorp.co.uk>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on INV-20251130 / VAT applied incorrectly

Laura / Marcus — I pulled the billing ledger and usage logs. Quick summary:

- There was a transient duplication during our end-of-month aggregation job on 2025-11-30 at 00:02 UTC that produced two identical billing entries for the dedicated-inference-pool for Eta Health. I've attached the service usage export for that window (service-usage-log-202511.csv).
- Our tax mapping shows the account currently set to "Business - UK" but it did not have the VAT ID populated in the invoice rendering step due to a missing profile field. The registration (GB999999999) is on file in our customer-verification folder, so this is an internal mapping bug.

Planned remediation:
- Issue a credit memo for the duplicated line (credit-memo-ETA-20251125.pdf).
- Re-issue corrected invoice INV-20251130-R1 with VAT reallocation (zero-rated intra-EU) and updated totals.
- Apply a goodwill service credit equal to the duplicated line to be visible on the next billing cycle, to keep the cash flow simple for Eta's AP team.

Questions for internal ops: 
- Can Finance generate the credit memo and corrected invoice by COB Friday 21 Nov?
- Laura: please confirm if we escalate to legal for any paperwork — since VAT ID is on file this should be a routine correction.

Tom — copying you so you're aware of the remediation steps. If you can provide the VAT confirmation screenshot, we'll attach it to the ticket to avoid recurrence.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: service-usage-log-202511.csv
From: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@etahealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Price <olivia.price@mccorp.co.uk>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 07:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on INV-20251130 / VAT applied incorrectly

Neha — thanks, that plan sounds good. I've attached the VAT registration page and a short remittance note to speed reconciliation. ETA prefers a credit memo + corrected invoice rather than a separate refund.

Bank / AP note (for the credit memo):
- Company: Eta Health Ltd
- VAT: GB999999999
- PO: PO-ETA-7845

If you issue INV-20251130-R1 and the credit memo this morning, we can net them against the outstanding amount and complete payment by next Wednesday.

Attachments: ETA_VAT_registration.pdf, remittance-note-ETA-PO-7845.pdf

Tom
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Barnes <tbarnes@etahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Olivia Price <olivia.price@mccorp.co.uk>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on INV-20251130 / VAT applied incorrectly

Tom / Olivia — quick update and confirmation.

- Credit memo (credit-memo-ETA-20251125.pdf) has been issued for the duplicated line.
- Corrected invoice INV-20251130-R1 has been generated and replaces the original; VAT has been reallocated per your EU VAT ID (zero-rated).
- We have applied a goodwill service credit equal to the duplicated line on your next invoice to simplify cashflow (visible as "Goodwill adjustment - Nov" on December invoice).

Next steps:
- Neha / Finance — please confirm the corrected invoice and credit memo were uploaded to the HubSpot deal folder and sent to tbarnes@etahealth.com.
- Tom — please confirm once your AP receives the documents; if you'd like us to resend via DocuSign or a direct PDF to your supplier portal, tell us which channel.

Apologies again for the mix-up. We'll also open a ticket with engineering to fix the aggregation edge case that caused the duplicate.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit-memo-ETA-20251125.pdf, INV-20251130-R1.pdf
